title: Cost tracker — uses DecisionTree for ancestor/descendant cost tracing, decay weighting
acceptance_criteria: CostTracker class: __init__(decision_tree, decay_fn) with dependency injection
trace_decision_cost(decision_id) -> dict with direct_cost, ancestor_costs, descendant_costs
apply_decay_weighting(costs, decay_scores) -> dict[str, float] pure function
Reuses decay_score from knowledge_decay for confidence weighting
All IO errors raise CostError, no silent failures
